subject: Audit blackout windows; observer accommodation and evidence sampling approach
messages:
From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@aegisaudit.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Audit logistics — blackout windows, observer needs, and sample approach

Logan —

Thanks for the fast onboarding call yesterday. A couple of follow-ups as we lock in dates for the ISO/FedRAMP evidence collection window for Acme Corp:

- Blackout windows: Acme is requesting we identify any "blackout" windows (maintenance, deploy freeze, or other planned downtime) during the audit week so their observers can avoid scheduling. Do we have planned infra maintenance or model rollout windows between Dec 6–10?

- Observer accommodations: Acme has two observers who will want read-only view access to the console and a Zoom dial-in for walkthroughs. Please confirm whether we can provide temporary SCIM accounts scoped to view-only and whether we can mute sensitive demo data during live sessions.

- Sample selection & evidence matrix: Attached is our proposed sample_matrix.csv. For FedRAMP, the auditor will target control families with log sampling (e.g., access logs, KMS key usage, change control records). For ISO 27001 we typically see document-based evidence (policies, training records) plus operational evidence. Can you confirm owners for the following types: access logs (app infra), KMS/HSM key rotation, deployment runbooks, and incident ticket exports?

If you can cc the control owners I can sync sample sizes and arrive at a final evidence pull list by EOD Monday.

Thanks —
Emily Zhang
Senior Auditor | AegisAudit
emily.zhang@aegisaudit.com
+1 (415) 555-1212

Attachments: audit_scope.pdf, sample_matrix.csv

Appreciate the summary and the matrix. Quick answers up front: no planned infra maintenance or model rollouts during Dec 6–10 that would cause a blackout window. We will enforce a freeze from Dec 4–12 on non-critical deploys to be safe.

On observer access: we can provision temporary SSO-linked, read-only accounts scoped to the Console (no access to raw S3 buckets or KMS secrets). We will also set up a dedicated meeting bridge and a sanitized demo workspace for walkthroughs.

Control owners (prelim):
- Access logs (app infra): Vivek Kulkarni (infra)
- KMS key rotation: Marissa Cole (security ops)
- Deployment runbooks / change control: Lauren Bishop (platform)
- Incident exports / CS tickets: Logan Wright (security reviews + CS)

Cc-ing Lauren and Vivek to confirm. If you need any escalation or an SLA exception for sampling windows, flag it and we will route to leadership.

— Logan

Thanks all — this is very helpful. A few quick clarifications before I finalize the audit plan:

- The Dec 6–12 freeze + time-bound SCIM accounts works for Acme. For the observer sessions we will request two 60-minute walkthrough windows (one for FedRAMP control families, one for ISO documentation). Please include a brief agenda for each.

- For sampling: we'll request tenant-scoped access logs covering the prior 120 days for controls that rely on authentication and session records. If you can produce a filtered export and a short readme explaining filtering criteria, we can avoid unnecessary data transfer.

- KMS rotation evidence: we typically request key rotation timestamps and any rotation policy documents. If Marissa can confirm an export format (CSV or PDF timeline), that helps us size the sample.

If you can get the runbook, PR diffs, and the log/export capability notes into the Drive folder by COB Monday (11/30), we'll record the evidence list and send a formal DocuSign engagement letter for Acme's approval. I will also attach a short observer NDA for signature.

Emily Zhang
Senior Auditor | AegisAudit
